final: SELECT si.riskeval, AVG(sc.gbsize * 1.0 / sc.spanmin) AS avg_gb_per_scan_minute FROM scans sc JOIN sites si ON sc.zoneref = si.zoneregistry WHERE sc.chronotag BETWEEN '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' AND si.riskeval IS NOT NULL AND sc.gbsize IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND sc.spanmin > 0 GROUP BY si.riskeval
